title: Law to require training on uterine fibroids care
summary: This bill would require the Health Department to develop and conduct trainings for health care providers on diagnosing and treating uterine fibroids, including on implicit bias, disparities and informed consent. The department would conduct outreach to make providers aware of the trainings and could help incorporate them into Health and Hospitals Corporation professional development. Starting one year after the law takes effect, and annually after that, the department would report on the trainings and the number of providers who completed them.
